games.name: [UPDATE] Knife Simulator
games.desc:
Welcome to Knife Simulator!
Kill everyone and rise to the top with the most kills and money in this knife skillshot simulator!

Click - Melee slash knife
Hold click - Throw knife

When you are the king, you get bonus gold for killing people. The next person to kill after the king dies becomes the king. The king is indicated by a crown on his or her head and a red arrow above them.

games.name: The Nearly Impossible Obby
games.desc:
Challenge your skills in The Nearly Impossible Obby, a thrilling platformer adventure with 265 stages of escalating difficulty. Do you have what it takes to conquer all of the obstacles and emerge the Obby Master? Only 1% can, good luck...

Liking the game but it gets too difficult for you? No worries, once you have completed at least 60 stages—you can Rebirth for gems allowing you to unlock unique trails and halos. In addition, you can compete for a spot on the Rebirth leaderboard!

Press R to go back to your stage, or Y if you are on controller. 

Tags: Obby, Parkour, Platformer, Obstacle Course, Tower, Easy, Hard, Impossible, Difficulty Chart, DCO, Lava

games.name: Shinjuku, 2006
games.desc:
In 2006, the Kabukicho entertainment district located in the Shinjuku Ward of Tokyo is experiencing its largest ever crime wave. Here, you'll scavenge, run, and kill to survive in this volatile city. Welcome to the Sleepless Town.

SHIFT to sprint. C to crouch. Hold RIGHT CLICK with a firearm in first-person to aim. BACKSPACE to drop an item. Damage an enemy when they're knocked down to eliminate them.
